g.text: Department of Laboratory Medicine - Haematology & Clinical Chemistry
UKAS Medical Laboratory 8842 - accredited to ISO 15189
Mild normocytic anaemia with a neutrophil leucocytosis, consistent with an acute inflammatory or infective process.
Renal function shows a mildly raised creatinine with eGFR 62 mL/min/1.73m² (CKD stage G2). Suggest clinical
correlation and a repeat FBC in 7-10 days. Flags: H = above reference range, L = below reference range.
